verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a file-conversion SaaS with a REST API and a Java SDK. It is not a coding agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server, and probes for agent-oriented artifacts (llms.txt, OpenAPI) all returned 404. The REST API and SDK are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
